# Mind Body Recovery

> An integrative clinical wellness sanctuary and practitioner training academy in Chennai, India, founded and directed by Sameer.

## Overview
Mind Body Recovery combines therapeutic hands-on clinical bodywork (acupuncture, traditional fire cupping, osteopathic alignment, foot and craniosacral reflexology, Ayurveda), somatic inquiry, cognitive uncoupling, and immersive 2-day reset retreats.

- **Founder & Clinical Director**: Sameer
- **Location**: Shanta Ayurveda Hospital, 23A, N Boag Rd, Drivers Colony, T. Nagar, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600017
- **Phone**: +91 90425 61651
- **Email**: tamilnadutherapist@gmail.com
- **Website**: https://mindbodyrecovery.in

## Core Clinical Modalities
- **Relax (Physical Decompression & Somatic Calming)**: Shirodhara medicated oil cascade, Ayurvedic pulse assessment, herbal Podikizhi bolus therapy, traditional fire cupping, craniosacral therapy, somatic movement inquiry, joint mobilization.
- **Rethink (Cognitive Uncoupling & Clinical Dialogue)**: 1-on-1 cognitive dialogue, brain power chart screening, meridian pathway analysis, mindful clinical study.
- **Rebuild (Sanctuary Retreat Living & Integration)**: 2-Day Reset Retreat at sanctuary campus featuring organic sattvic nutrition, barefoot sensory garden grounding, spine osteopathic alignment, balcony somatic movement, and quiet heritage suite stays.

## Mentorship & Training
- The Hands That Treat You Also Train The Hands of Others: Comprehensive professional training and mentorship in integrative physical decompression, acupuncture, cupping, and clinical assessment for practitioners and doctors worldwide.
